title: Real-Time Stock Trading & Matching Engine
points: Engineered an in-memory order-matching engine in TypeScript and Node.js for high-concurrency order books.
Employs PostgreSQL row-level locks for atomic balance reservations, preventing race conditions under concurrent trading.
Integrates Redis Pub/Sub for sub-200ms market state broadcasting and BullMQ for reliable distributed task queue management.

title: Medical Assistant (Orca / MediBot)
points: Built a clinical diagnostic assistant using LangChain, FAISS vector index, and Google Gemini Pro.
Features multi-modal symptom parsing with source-grounded clinical reference retrieval.
Reduces medical query hallucinations by 25% through context-grounded retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

title: PriceVista
points: Automated e-commerce price monitoring platform tracking Amazon products with historical price trend charts.
Runs automated scraping workflows with Cheerio and maintains historical price documents in MongoDB.
Dispatches instant automated email notifications to subscribers when prices drop by 40% or more.

title: Shinka Jinzai (SIH 2024)
points: Smart India Hackathon 2024 finalist project for Warehouse Management Services (WMS).
Performs deep-learning video frame interpolation and real-time visual telemetry displays.
Constructed with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Firestore, and AI video synthesis pipelines.

title: AI Hologram Video Generator
points: Academic research converting standard 2D video feeds into 3D holographic projection formats in real-time.
Implements deep neural depth estimation and spatial rendering pipelines for optical pyramid displays.
Peer-reviewed research publication indexed in Semantic Scholar and ResearchGate.

title: Newsify
points: Curates verified real-time regional and international news feeds into an accessible news aggregation feed.
Incorporates hands-free text-to-speech audio narration using ResponsiveVoice synthesis.
Engineered with React.js, Tailwind CSS, Google Firestore, and third-party REST APIs.

title: OrcaMedia
points: Full-stack social platform developed with React, Node.js, Express, and relational MySQL.
Implements JWT authentication, dynamic user feeds, media uploads, and post interaction workflows.
Built with responsive modular UI components and resilient backend API error handling.
